newsitem.title: USA: Media General net to hurt from Park deal.
newsitem.headline: Media General net to hurt from Park deal.

text.p: Media General Inc said on Friday that its acquisition of Park Communications will hurt its first quarter net income due to amortization of goodwill, but its cash flow will improve.
J. Stewart Bryan III said in a statement reported earnings "will take a step backward to accommodate the goodwill amortization" associated with the Park Communications acquisition.
The acquisition of Park Communications will result in amortization of goodwiil at a rate of $22 million per year for five years, a Media General spokesman said.
After the five year period, Park will be a contributor to the company's earnings per share, a Media General spokesman said.
The acquisition of Park Communications was completed in January for $710 million.
